name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Father's Vengeance) — 1 Basic — Zillah's Litany

system.description: Speak the relevant passages from The Book of Nod to your target to gain hazy psychic impressions of any blood bonds or Vinculi affecting her. Make a Simple Test for each vampire she is bonded to: a tie yields a hazy facial impression, a win yields a face, name, and psychic impression. Only affects Cainites.
